usedFor: Shopify takes orders, and Timesheet logs the follow-up work when “Order Cancelled” runs “Create a Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create a Task” in Timesheet
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order becomes a task to track, so the time spent on it is visible.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so its tasks appear after a scheduled check.
